name: Tilde Sharp
source:
A Lieutenant in the Leazish Royal Guard.
This ambitious and determined young woman aspires to excel in every domain: literature, martial arts, beauty, and etiquette. Hooked on praise and adoration, she never hesitates to burn the midnight oil to achieve her goals. However, in line with her motto, "always be elegant," she presents herself as a swan gliding effortlessly on the surface while paddling like mad beneath the water.

As Rance embarks on his adventures around Kalar Village, Lia orders Tilde to join Rance's party. Eager to forge connections with individuals of great potential, she even shares an intimate moment with Rance, a man renowned for his extraordinary talent.

[Based on official site and in-game content]
